frames.barycentric: Query barycentric wavelength cb+x. Native topocentric-air wavelength first multiplied by(1+BERVepoch/c) once.
frames.topocentric: One fixed ct=cb/(1+BERVdiscovery/c), anchored to V2E2-0087 observed on 2025-04-29 with BERV 3.40485846065643 km/s. Query barycentric wavelength (ct+x)*(1+BERVepoch/c), equivalent to native topocentric wavelength ct+x. Recompute from the exact C012 center; no HD106515A numeric anchor is reused and no recentering occurs.
frames.native_polynomial: Ascending coefficient polynomial at zero-based native pixel0..4095, inherited topocentric air convention; no wavelength unit/air-vacuum conversion.

grid.core: abs(x)<=0.25: 51 sampled centers [-0.25,+0.25]. Exact original core [3869.0175,3869.5175] Angstrom; not a fitted physical linewidth.
grid.interpolation: Linear without extrapolation; mask brackets >1.51 times the median full-source barycentric wavelength step. Save selected source points plus one bracket on each side and the exact full-source spacing.

normalization.rule: Per profile and frame, pooled signed median of native samples with 1.5<=abs(frame offset)<=3, requiring at least 20 finite samples separately in each flank and a positive pooled median. No fitted background, continuum or line model.
normalization.missing: Zero native left/right coverage is MISSING_LEFT/RIGHT_FLANK_COVERAGE; insufficient finite counts are separate. Invalid or nonpositive references keep raw-only arrays and block normalized RMS. No moved flanks, sign flip, shrink or extrapolation.
normalization.context: Separate left/right native and finite counts, medians and nonpositive fractions; available median distinct from valid reference; signed-window nonpositive fraction and positive finite ERR coverage. Native BUNIT unspecified; merged ADU verified.
normalization.noise: First-difference 1.4826 MAD / sqrt(2) of finite adjacent source samples with both endpoints in the same fixed flank and spacing <=1.51 times median step. Never bridge flanks or gaps. Descriptive low-reference flag median<=3*proxy only if reference valid; no formal SNR.
normalization.structured_neighbor: Retain every fixed-flank sample and any structured spectrum without masks or an assumed line-free region. This is a new target-specific bounded window, but original HD112410 event/epoch/raw evidence exists. Pooled medians are descriptive reference levels, not fitted or established line-free continua.

comparisons.merged: 7 target-specific epochs × 1 fixed reference × 2 frames × 2 regions = 28 records, including 4 identical-product self rows.
comparisons.native: 2 native covering-order context(s) × 2 frames × 2 regions = 8 same-exposure native-to-merged records; shared extraction is dependent, not another observation or a physical flux ratio.
comparisons.statistics: Unshifted raw Pearson requires at least ceil(.8*Nregion) common finite raw samples and nonzero exact range. Normalized RMS requires that support in common finite normalized samples. Raw-only profiles block normalized RMS but retain adequately covered raw Pearson. Counts and reasons remain explicit.
comparisons.self_and_dependency_flags: Retain same_exposure and identical_product_self_pair flags, one fixed April 2025 discovery and all seven reused HD112410 products. A different wavelength window or same-target context does not erase the existing original epoch/raw evidence.

bounded_arrays: Save 9 pre-interpolation source windows with exact indices, original-frame and barycentric wavelengths, signed flux, ERR (NaN for unavailable native errors), source hashes, BERV and full-source spacing. Read only the union needed by both fixed-frame windows plus brackets; no extrapolation or original-pipeline replay.
headers: Check all seven HD112410 merged headers and the April 2025 native header before new flux access: exact identities/hashes/metadata, numeric BERV, merged barycentric-air Angstrom/ADU and unique WAVE/FLUX/ERR single-exposure tables, native 72×4096 shape and freshly recorded polynomial coefficients for every selected order. Geometric support, finite flux, reference validity and historical mapping reliability remain distinct.
preserved_raw_context: Copy the exact historical V2E2-0087 raw/native NPZ panel(s) and display original raw_cutout/raw_excess after release at separate full scales. Preserve primary U, secondary U and adopted U reviews and each mapping stage, including original order 2 local/baseline failures alongside true global/later five-window diagnostics; order 3 retains true at every historical stage. No new registration, subtraction, spatial model, pixel statistic or origin claim.

release_contract.policy: Exact public method freeze and input hashes before new observed values; no network; one-shot output refuses overwrite; all source and release hashes rechecked after execution.

plot_rules: Four fixed figures: all seven target-specific merged epochs in broad/core signed and scaled views in both frames, every retained native order, and every original raw/excess pair. The 0087/R013 marker is the catalog/discovery coordinate, not a fitted peak. Keep raw-only reasons, low/invalid references and partial support visible. Same-quantity merged scales match across frames; native raw scales match across frames per order. Every finite value remains with 5 percent margins; raw images use separate full extrema. No smoothing, clipping, favorable epoch choice or contrast variant.
limitations: Post-detection context of one U record and seven reused HD112410 exposures. No new observing time, independent detection or archive-wide completeness; V2E2-0087 remains U.
